title: Te Reo o te Whakapono Huna
intro: I waenganui o te kooti nanakia, i te wā i noho ai te kore whakapono hei ture o te whenua, i haere tētahi wairua mokemoke i runga i te taura o te whakapono me te wehi. I whakarongo tēnei tangata, e tata ana ki te pokapū o te mana, i te wā i tūtaki ai te karere a te poropiti ki te whakahawea me ngā whakawehi. I tae mai tētahi wā o te pono, ā, i akiaki i tēnei tangata ki te whiriwhiri i waenga i te haumaru puku me te kōrero i tētahi pono morearea. Ka taea e koe te hura i te tuakiri o tēnei kaitautoko toa?
clues: I noho ahau i roto i te whare o tētahi rangatira nanakia, e kite kanohi ana i te whakapehapeha i whakakahore i ngā tohu atua.
I huna e ahau tōku whakapono, he taonga huna i roto i te whare karakia whakapakoko.
I rongo ahau i te rangatira i mahi ahau ki te whakatakoto mahere ki te patu i tētahi karere a Allah, he tangata ko Mohi tōna ingoa.
I pātai ahau i ō rātou whakaaro, me te whakamahara i a rātou ki te mutunga o te iwi o Noa, o Āta, me te Thamud.
I pātai atu ahau i tētahi pātai whakahē ki tōku iwi: 'Ki te mea he tangata teka ia, ka tau tana teka ki a ia; engari ki te mea he pono ia, ka pā mai ētahi o ana kupu whakaari ki a koe.'
Hei tauira o te whakapono te kōrero mō taku pūrākau i roto i te sura e kīia nei ko 'Te Kaiwhakaora,' i reira ahau i whakatūpato ai i tōku iwi kia kaua e mahi tinihanga a te hunga whai mana.

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
